overview: Kuwait is a small country at the northern end of the Persian Gulf, between Iraq and Saudi Arabia. Its capital is Kuwait City. Kuwait became independent from British protection in 1961. In 1990 it was invaded by Iraq, and it was freed in the Gulf War of 1991. Oil has made it one of the richest countries in the world.

geography.text: Kuwait is flat, dry desert with extremely hot summers. Kuwait Bay cuts into its coast, and it has a few islands, the largest being Bubiyan. There are no rivers or lakes, and most of its fresh water comes from taking the salt out of seawater.

history.text: Kuwait grew as a trading and pearl-diving port, ruled by the Al Sabah family since the 1700s. It became a British protectorate in 1899 and found oil in 1938. Kuwait became independent in 1961. In 1990 Iraq invaded and occupied it, until a US-led coalition drove Iraqi forces out in 1991.

events.title: Al Sabah rule
events.text: The Al Sabah family begins ruling Kuwait.

events.title: British protection
events.text: Kuwait signs a protection treaty with Britain.

government.text: Kuwait is a constitutional monarchy ruled by an Emir from the Al Sabah family. It had one of the most active elected parliaments in the Gulf, but in 2024 the Emir suspended parliament for up to four years.

economy.text: Kuwait has some of the largest oil reserves in the world, and oil makes up most of its exports and government income. Kuwaitis pay no income tax, and most work for the government. A large sovereign wealth fund, set up in 1953, invests its oil money.

culture.text: Before oil, Kuwait lived from pearl diving, fishing and sea trade. The Kuwait Towers, built in the 1970s, are the national symbol. Diwaniya, gatherings where men meet to talk and discuss politics, are a key part of social life.

items.title: Kuwait Towers
items.text: Three towers on the coast, opened in 1979.

items.title: Diwaniya
items.text: Evening gatherings in homes to talk and debate.

sport.text: Football is the most popular sport. Kuwait won the Asian Cup in 1980 and played at the 1982 World Cup. Shooting has brought the country Olympic medals.

items.text: Kuwait played at the men's World Cup.
